36. The salaries of the members of the Commission shall
be  determined  by  the  Cabinet  of  Ministers  and  shall  be
charged  on  the  Consolidated  Fund  and  shall  not  be
diminished during their terms of office.
37. The Commission shall cause proper accounts to be
kept of its income and expenditure, and assets and liabilities.
The  accounts  of  the  Commission  shall  be  audited  by  the
Auditor-General in terms of Article 154 of the Constitution.
38. The Commission shall submit annual reports of the
Commission’s  accounts  to  Parliament,  which  shall  be
simultaneously  published  and  disseminated  to  the  public
including through electronic media and internet.
